title: Lens Replacement Log Days Worn Leaderboard
dataSources: Contact lens orders (`contacts:order`), glasses prescriptions (`glasses:prescription`), vision exams (`vision:exam`), and lens replacement logs (`lens:replacement`).
app: Contact lens order exports, glasses prescription records, vision exam logs, and lens replacement reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lens:replacement days_worn=*
| stats sum(days_worn) as total_value, avg(days_worn) as avg_value by replacement_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks replacement type values by total and average days worn across lens replacement log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `days_worn` values for each lens replacement log event and review total and average days worn by replacement type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total days worn.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which replacement type shows the biggest days worn numbers in your lens replacement log data.
